value.rationale: A magnetic single-edge holonomy is a natural continuous parameter interpolating a singular periodic kernel and an antiperiodic signed-cycle problem. The exact real norm is a new explicit optimal inverse-Green ℓ∞→ℓ² quantity at every intermediate flux; optimizer rigidity changes abruptly at the antiperiodic endpoint. The sharp scalar-field gap and noncommuting small-flux/large-dimension limits are mathematically motivated structural information, not routine computational slices. The previously solved endpoint is excluded from the contribution.
